<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="#060606" name="theme-color"/>
<meta content="Pratip Kumar Das — Senior Lead designer portfolio. Campaigns, brand communication, social, packaging, print, digital and AI-assisted creative workflows." name="description"/>
<title>Pratip Kumar Das — Senior Lead Designer</title>
<!-- RUN-READY: portfolio images are embedded directly in their IMG tags; no JS hydration required -->
<style>
:root{--bg:#060606;--surface:#0d0d0d;--surface2:#121212;--text:#f5f4ef;--muted:#9a9a95;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.13);--blue:#6272ff;--acid:#caff3a;--hot:#ff5b3d;--radius:24px;--max:1540px;--pad:clamp(20px,4vw,68px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth;background:var(--bg)}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}body.modal-open{overflow:hidden}a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}button,input,textarea{font:inherit}button{color:inherit}img{display:block;width:100%}::selection{background:var(--acid);color:#070707}
/* motion/performance polish */
.mouse-dot,.mouse-ring,.mouse-trail,.cursor,.hero-art,.art-card{will-change:transform}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.reveal{transition-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.16,.72,.16,1)}}

body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9998;opacity:.035;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 180 180' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")}

body.intro-active{overflow:hidden}
.preloader{--px:0px;--py:0px;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;overflow:hidden;background:#050505;color:#fff;opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .78s cubic-bezier(.22,.72,.16,1),visibility .78s}
.preloader.done{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.intro-bg{position:absolute;inset:-7%;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(2,2,2,.48),rgba(2,2,2,.74)),url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-position:center;background-size:cover;filter:blur(34px) saturate(.7);transform:scale(1.16);animation:introBg 4.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1) both;will-change:transform,filter}
.intro-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.22;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.05) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:42px 42px;mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#000 18%,#000 82%,transparent)}
.intro-noise{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.13;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 160 160' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.85' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.45'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");mix-blend-mode:soft-light}
.intro-layout{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:clamp(18px,3vw,46px)}
.intro-card-shell{height:min(90svh,980px);aspect-ratio:4/5;max-width:min(78vw,920px);border-radius:clamp(14px,2vw,28px);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 38px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.55);animation:introShell 4.8s cubic-bezier(.16,.78,.16,1) both;will-change:transform,clip-path}
.intro-card{width:100%;height:100%;transform:perspective(1400px) translate3d(calc(var(--px)*.025),calc(var(--py)*.025),0) rotateX(calc(var(--py)*-.0018deg)) rotateY(calc(var(--px)*.0018deg));transition:transform .16s linear;will-change:transform}
.intro-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.045);animation:introPoster 4.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both;will-change:transform,filter}
.intro-top,.intro-bottom{position:absolute;left:clamp(20px,4vw,64px);right:clamp(20px,4vw,64px);z-index:3;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:clamp(.62rem,.75vw,.78rem);font-weight:800;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.intro-top{top:clamp(20px,3.3vw,48px)}.intro-bottom{bottom:clamp(20px,3.3vw,48px)}
.intro-top strong,.intro-bottom strong{color:#fff;font-weight:950}.intro-top span,.intro-bottom span{animation:introMeta .7s ease both}.intro-top span:nth-child(2),.intro-bottom span:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.18s}
.intro-progress{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);z-index:6}.intro-progress i{display:block;width:0;height:100%;background:var(--acid);box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(202,255,58,.55)}
.intro-counter{font-size:clamp(1.2rem,2.4vw,2.4rem);letter-spacing:-.055em;font-weight:950;color:var(--acid);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.intro-title{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;font-size:clamp(4.4rem,14vw,14rem);line-height:.72;letter-spacing:-.085em;font-weight:1000;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;mix-blend-mode:difference;opacity:0;animation:introTitle 4.8s cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.12,1) both}
.intro-title em{display:block;font-style:normal;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.5px #fff;transform:translateX(10%)}
.intro-scan{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:0;right:0;height:1px;top:-2%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--acid),transparent);box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(202,255,58,.7);animation:introScan 3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) .6s both;opacity:.75}
.intro-skip{position:absolute;z-index:8;right:clamp(20px,4vw,64px);bottom:clamp(54px,5.5vw,82px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);background:rgba(6,6,6,.32);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}.intro-skip:hover{background:#fff;color:#070707}
.preloader.leaving .intro-card-shell{animation:none;transform:scale(1.12);filter:blur(8px);opacity:.1;transition:transform .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),filter .75s,opacity .6s}
.preloader.leaving .intro-title{animation:none;opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.14);transition:.55s ease}
@keyframes introBg{0%{transform:scale(1.28) translate3d(-1.8%,1.2%,0);filter:blur(42px) saturate(.45)}100%{transform:scale(1.13) translate3d(1.3%,-1%,0);filter:blur(30px) saturate(.75)}}
@keyframes introShell{0%{clip-path:inset(50% 48% round 24px);transform:translateY(5vh) scale(.82) rotate(-2deg)}22%{clip-path:inset(0 0 round 24px);transform:translateY(0) scale(.94) rotate(0)}72%{transform:scale(.97)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes introPoster{0%{transform:scale(1.2) translate3d(0,2.5%,0);filter:contrast(1.12) saturate(.75)}100%{transform:scale(1.045) translate3d(0,0,0);filter:contrast(1) saturate(1)}}
@keyframes introTitle{0%,18%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-44%) scale(.92)}32%,68%{opacity:.9;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}88%,100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-54%) scale(1.07)}}
@keyframes introMeta{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes introScan{0%{top:-2%;opacity:0}15%{opacity:.8}85%{opacity:.7}100%{top:102%;opacity:0}}
@media(max-width:700px){.intro-card-shell{height:min(78svh,760px);max-width:94vw}.intro-title{font-size:clamp(3.3rem,20vw,7rem)}.intro-top,.intro-bottom{align-items:flex-start}.intro-bottom{font-size:.58rem}.intro-top>span:first-child,.intro-bottom>span:first-child{max-width:60%}.intro-skip{bottom:72px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.intro-bg,.intro-card-shell,.intro-card img,.intro-title,.intro-scan,.intro-top span,.intro-bottom span{animation:none!important}.intro-card-shell{clip-path:none}.intro-title{opacity:.65}}

.shell{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding-left:var(--pad);padding-right:var(--pad)}.site-header{position:fixed;z-index:700;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(calc(100% - 28px),1480px);height:66px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:rgba(6,6,6,.74);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;padding:0 18px}.brand{font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.055em;font-size:1rem}.brand i{font-style:normal;color:var(--acid);font-size:.66em;vertical-align:top;margin-left:2px}.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px}.nav a{font-size:.82rem;color:#c3c3bd;transition:.2s}.nav a:hover{color:#fff}.head-actions{justify-self:end;display:flex;gap:8px}.pill{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:10px 14px;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;font-size:.78rem;transition:.22s}.pill:hover{background:var(--text);color:#080808}.pill.acid{background:var(--acid);border-color:var(--acid);color:#080808;font-weight:800}.menu-btn{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}.menu-btn span,.menu-btn:before,.menu-btn:after{content:"";display:block;width:16px;height:1px;background:#fff;margin:3px auto;transition:.2s}
.mobile-menu{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:650;background:#080808;padding:105px var(--pad) 40px;display:none;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}.mobile-menu.open{display:flex}.mobile-menu a{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,12vw,5rem);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.06em;line-height:.98;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 0}.mobile-menu small{color:var(--muted)}
.hero{min-height:100svh;padding-top:150px;padding-bottom:70px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(360px,.6fr);gap:clamp(30px,5vw,90px);align-items:center}.hero-kicker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.72rem;color:#b7b7b1}.dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(202,255,58,.55)}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(4.4rem,9vw,10.4rem);line-height:.78;letter-spacing:-.075em;margin:28px 0 36px;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:950}.hero h1 span{display:block}.hero h1 .stroke{color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.4px var(--text)}.hero h1 .blue{color:var(--blue)}.hero-copy{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,610px) auto;gap:28px;align-items:end;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:22px}.hero-copy p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:clamp(1rem,1.4vw,1.22rem);line-height:1.55}.hero-copy p strong{display:block;color:var(--text);font-size:clamp(1.45rem,2.15vw,2.15rem);line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.035em;font-weight:950;margin-bottom:12px}.hero-copy p span{display:block;max-width:560px}.scroll-orb{width:108px;height:108px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);color:#070707;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-weight:900;font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.05;transform:rotate(-8deg);transition:.25s}.scroll-orb:hover{transform:rotate(0) scale(1.05)}
.hero-art{height:min(72vh,720px);min-height:540px;position:relative}.art-card{position:absolute;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);box-shadow:0 26px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.34);background:#111;transition:transform .25s ease;will-change:translate,transform}.art-card img{height:100%;object-fit:cover}.art-a{width:60%;height:52%;left:5%;top:8%;transform:rotate(-7deg);animation:floatCardA 5.8s ease-in-out infinite}.art-b{width:52%;height:52%;right:3%;top:28%;transform:rotate(7deg);animation:floatCardB 7.1s ease-in-out infinite .45s}.art-c{width:52%;height:44%;left:14%;bottom:2%;transform:rotate(3deg);animation:floatCardC 6.4s ease-in-out infinite .9s}@keyframes floatCardA{0%,100%{translate:0 0}25%{translate:-7px -14px}52%{translate:5px -25px}78%{translate:10px -9px}}@keyframes floatCardB{0%,100%{translate:0 0}22%{translate:11px -8px}48%{translate:-6px -20px}73%{translate:-12px 2px}}@keyframes floatCardC{0%,100%{translate:0 0}28%{translate:-10px 7px}55%{translate:7px -13px}82%{translate:13px 5px}}.hero-art:hover .art-card{animation-play-state:paused}.art-sticker{position:absolute;right:2%;top:5%;background:var(--hot);color:#fff;padding:14px 15px;font-weight:950;font-size:.72rem;line-height:1.05;transform:rotate(6deg);z-index:3}.art-note{position:absolute;left:-3%;bottom:7%;background:#fff;color:#080808;padding:12px 13px;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:900;line-height:1.08;transform:rotate(-5deg);z-index:3}.hero-art:hover .art-a{transform:rotate(-3deg)}.hero-art:hover .art-b{transform:rotate(3deg)}.hero-art:hover .art-c{transform:rotate(-2deg)}
.ticker{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;background:#0b0b0b}.ticker-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:ticker 28s linear infinite;padding:13px 0}.ticker-track span{font-size:clamp(1.4rem,2.5vw,2.7rem);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:1.2em}.ticker-track span:nth-child(odd){color:var(--acid)}@keyframes ticker{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.section{padding-top:130px;padding-bottom:130px}.section-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .55fr;gap:50px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:62px}.eyebrow{display:block;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:.7rem;color:#8d8d88;margin-bottom:14px}.section-head h2,.split-title{font-size:clamp(3rem,6vw,6.6rem);line-height:.86;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:0;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:950}.section-head h2 em,.split-title em{font-style:normal;color:var(--blue)}.section-head p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;font-size:1.03rem}.filter-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:26px}.filter-btn{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:#aaa;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.76rem}.filter-btn.active,.filter-btn:hover{background:var(--text);color:#070707;border-color:var(--text)}
.work-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr);gap:18px}.work-card{grid-column:span 4;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;min-width:0}.work-card:nth-child(1),.work-card:nth-child(4),.work-card:nth-child(7){grid-column:span 4}.work-card.hidden{display:none}.work-media{display:block;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#121212;border-radius:18px;aspect-ratio:4/5;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.work-card:nth-child(1) .work-media,.work-card:nth-child(4) .work-media,.work-card:nth-child(7) .work-media{aspect-ratio:4/5}.work-media img{height:100%;object-fit:contain;background:#0f0f0f;transition:transform .65s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),filter .35s}.work-card:hover img{transform:scale(1.04);filter:saturate(1.08)}.view-pill{position:absolute;right:14px;bottom:14px;background:var(--acid);color:#070707;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:900;transform:translateY(18px);opacity:0;transition:.25s}.work-card:hover .view-pill{transform:none;opacity:1}.work-info{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;padding:15px 2px 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.work-num{display:none!important}.work-year{font-size:.72rem;color:#70706d}.work-info b{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;line-height:1.1}.work-info small{display:block;color:#73736f;margin-top:5px}
.shadowfax{margin-top:120px;background:var(--blue);color:#fff;border-radius:32px;padding:clamp(28px,5vw,74px);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.shadowfax:after{content:"SF";position:absolute;right:-1vw;bottom:-7vw;font-size:clamp(11rem,28vw,30rem);font-weight:950;line-height:.7;letter-spacing:-.1em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}.shadow-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .8fr;gap:70px;position:relative;z-index:1}.shadowfax .eyebrow{color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)}.shadowfax h3{font-size:clamp(3.5rem,7vw,8rem);line-height:.82;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:0 0 28px;text-transform:uppercase}.shadowfax .lead{font-size:clamp(1.25rem,2vw,2rem);max-width:760px;line-height:1.25}.shadow-points{display:grid;gap:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);align-self:end}.shadow-points div{background:rgba(30,35,120,.36);padding:18px 20px}.shadow-points b{display:block;margin-bottom:4px}.shadow-points span{font-size:.86rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.about-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:80px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:44px}.about-big{font-size:clamp(2rem,3.4vw,3.8rem);line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.045em;margin:0 0 30px}.about-copy p:not(.about-big){color:var(--muted);line-height:1.72;max-width:720px}.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}.stat{background:#0c0c0c;min-height:190px;padding:22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}.stat strong{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,5vw,5.5rem);letter-spacing:-.07em;color:var(--acid)}.stat span{color:#8e8e89;font-size:.86rem}
.cap-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line)}.cap{background:#0b0b0b;padding:28px;min-height:250px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;transition:.25s}.cap:hover{background:#111}.cap .n{color:#696965;font-size:.74rem}.cap b{font-size:clamp(1.45rem,2vw,2.05rem);line-height:1.05}.cap p{margin:0;color:#7f7f7a;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.5}.toolcloud{margin-top:34px;display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.toolcloud span{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:11px 14px;color:#aaa;font-size:.8rem;transition:.2s}.toolcloud span:hover{background:var(--acid);border-color:var(--acid);color:#070707;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.timeline{border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.job{display:grid;grid-template-columns:180px 1fr 1fr;gap:28px;padding:28px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:.22s}.job:hover{background:#0b0b0b;padding-left:14px;padding-right:14px}.job.current{border-left:4px solid var(--acid);padding-left:16px}.job time{font-size:.74rem;color:#73736f;letter-spacing:.08em}.job h3{font-size:1.25rem;margin:0 0 5px}.job .company{color:#8f8f89;font-size:.9rem}.job .desc{color:#777772;line-height:1.55;font-size:.9rem}
.edu-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}.edu-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:#0b0b0b;padding:26px}.edu-card h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:1.2rem}.edu-card p{color:#81817d;margin:0;line-height:1.6}.award-list{margin-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.award{display:grid;grid-template-columns:100px 1fr auto;gap:20px;padding:17px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:center}.award span{font-size:.74rem;color:#70706d}.award b{font-size:.94rem}.award small{color:#71716d;text-align:right}
.contact{padding-top:145px;padding-bottom:46px}.contact-card{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:20px}.contact-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;color:#858580;font-size:.86rem}.contact-title{font-size:clamp(4rem,10vw,11rem);font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.075em;line-height:.77;text-transform:uppercase;margin:80px 0 70px;display:block}.contact-title span{color:var(--blue);transition:.25s}.contact-title:hover span{color:var(--acid)}.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .75fr;gap:70px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:34px}.contact-links{display:grid;gap:10px}.contact-links a{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 0;font-size:1.05rem}.contact-links a:hover{color:var(--acid)}.contact-form{display:grid;gap:12px}.field{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#0c0c0c;color:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:15px;outline:0}.field:focus{border-color:var(--blue)}textarea.field{min-height:120px;resize:vertical}.submit{border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--acid);color:#070707;padding:14px 18px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}.footer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:70px;padding-top:20px;color:#6f6f6b;font-size:.75rem}.footer span:nth-child(2){text-align:center}.footer span:last-child{text-align:right}

.cursor{position:fixed;z-index:9999;left:0;top:0;width:84px;height:84px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);color:#070707;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:950;font-size:.65rem;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0);transition:transform .16s}.cursor.on{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}

/* Mouse movement animation — added without changing the page layout */
.mouse-dot,.mouse-ring,.mouse-trail{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:9997;border-radius:50%;will-change:transform,opacity}
.mouse-dot{width:7px;height:7px;background:#fff;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);mix-blend-mode:difference;z-index:10001}
.mouse-ring{width:34px;height:34px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55);transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:width .22s ease,height .22s ease,border-color .22s ease,background .22s ease;z-index:10000}
.mouse-ring.hover{width:58px;height:58px;border-color:var(--acid);background:rgba(214,255,53,.055)}
.mouse-ring.click{width:24px;height:24px;background:rgba(214,255,53,.16);border-color:var(--acid)}
.mouse-trail{width:8px;height:8px;background:var(--blue);opacity:.22;filter:blur(.2px);z-index:9996;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.mouse-trail:nth-of-type(2n){background:var(--acid)}
@media(max-width:680px),(pointer:coarse){.mouse-dot,.mouse-ring,.mouse-trail{display:none!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mouse-trail{display:none!important}.mouse-ring{transition:none}}


/* === Portfolio depth upgrade: same visual system, more professional context === */
.scroll-progress{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--acid),var(--blue));z-index:12000;pointer-events:none;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(202,255,58,.35)}
.nav a.active{color:#fff}.nav a.active:after{content:'';display:block;height:1px;background:var(--acid);margin-top:5px;transform-origin:left}
.brand-proof{padding-top:46px;padding-bottom:30px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.brand-proof-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:18px}.brand-proof-top .eyebrow{margin:0}.brand-proof-note{color:var(--muted);font-size:.76rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.brand-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#090909}.brand-row span{min-height:82px;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:16px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);font-size:clamp(.68rem,1vw,.88rem);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;color:#d9d9d4;transition:.25s}.brand-row span:last-child{border-right:0}.brand-row span:hover{background:var(--text);color:#070707;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.sector-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}.sector-row span{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 11px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.11em}
.process-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;background:#090909}.process-step{position:relative;min-height:330px;padding:30px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;border-right:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .3s ease,background .3s,color .3s}.process-step:last-child{border-right:0}.process-step:hover{background:var(--acid);color:#080808;transform:translateY(-8px)}.process-step:hover p{color:rgba(8,8,8,.7)}.process-no{font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--muted)}.process-step:hover .process-no{color:rgba(8,8,8,.6)}.process-step b{display:block;font-size:clamp(1.45rem,2vw,2.2rem);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.045em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px}.process-step p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;margin:0;font-size:.92rem;transition:.3s}.process-arrow{font-size:2rem;align-self:flex-end}.process-foot{margin-top:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:13px 20px;color:#cfcfc9;font-size:.67rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em}.process-foot i{font-style:normal;color:var(--acid)}
.case-story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin:18px 0 54px}.case-story article{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);padding:22px;min-height:190px}.case-story small{display:block;color:var(--acid);font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:18px}.case-story p{margin:0;color:#d0d0ca;line-height:1.65;font-size:.95rem}
.back-top{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;z-index:620;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(8,8,8,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);pointer-events:none;transition:.25s}.back-top.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);pointer-events:auto}.back-top:hover{background:var(--acid);color:#080808;border-color:var(--acid)}
@media(max-width:1000px){.brand-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.brand-row span{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.brand-row span:nth-child(3n){border-right:0}.process-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.process-step:nth-child(2){border-right:0}.process-step:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.case-story{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:680px){.brand-proof{padding-top:30px}.brand-proof-top{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.brand-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.brand-row span:nth-child(3n){border-right:1px solid var(--line)}.brand-row span:nth-child(2n){border-right:0}.process-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.process-step{min-height:240px;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.process-step:last-child{border-bottom:0}.process-foot{border-radius:20px;justify-content:flex-start}.back-top{right:14px;bottom:14px}}


.stat-counter{display:inline-block;min-width:1.55ch;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;will-change:contents}

/* Interactive self-portrait — inspired by the supplied reference, adapted for Pratip */
.persona-sketch{margin-top:54px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#111 0%,#090909 72%);border:1px solid #262626;border-radius:34px;padding:30px;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4);position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.persona-sketch:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-30%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 25% 20%,rgba(201,255,35,.07),transparent 27%),radial-gradient(circle at 85% 12%,rgba(79,101,255,.08),transparent 25%);pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
.persona-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:18px;color:#f4f3ed;font-size:.73rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:20px}
.persona-top span:last-child{text-align:right;color:#a8a8a2}.persona-star{font-size:2.4rem;line-height:1;color:#e7ff38;font-weight:400;animation:personaSpin 11s linear infinite}@keyframes personaSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.persona-inner{border:1px solid #2a2a2a;border-radius:28px;padding:24px;background:rgba(8,8,8,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.persona-head,.persona-slider-label,.persona-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase}.persona-head{padding-bottom:18px}.persona-head span:last-child,.persona-slider-label span:last-child{color:#e7ff38}
.persona-stage{position:relative;min-height:620px;border:1px solid #343434;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;background:#0b0b0b;display:grid;place-items:center}
.persona-stage:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:20px;border:1px dashed #282828;border-radius:18px;pointer-events:none}.persona-stage:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.018) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.018) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:28px 28px;opacity:.65;pointer-events:none}
.persona-orbit{position:absolute;width:430px;height:430px;border:2px dashed #313131;border-radius:50%;right:-210px;top:-72px;opacity:.9;pointer-events:none}
.persona-cross{position:absolute;width:18px;height:18px;opacity:.42}.persona-cross:before,.persona-cross:after{content:"";position:absolute;background:#aaa}.persona-cross:before{left:8px;top:0;width:1px;height:18px}.persona-cross:after{top:8px;left:0;width:18px;height:1px}.persona-cross.a{left:8%;top:29%}.persona-cross.b{right:10%;top:31%}
.persona-art-wrap{position:absolute;inset:34px 46px 0;display:grid;place-items:end center;pointer-events:none}.persona-art{width:min(95%,730px);height:auto;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,255,255,.03))}.persona-ghost{opacity:0}.persona-reveal{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:end center;clip-path:circle(0% at 50% 42%);opacity:0;transition:clip-path .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),opacity .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);will-change:clip-path,opacity}.persona-reveal .persona-art{opacity:1}
.persona-pen{position:absolute;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:#e7ff38;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(231,255,56,.14),0 0 24px rgba(231,255,56,.45);left:50%;top:42%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);opacity:0;transition:left .12s linear,top .12s linear,opacity .18s ease;z-index:4;pointer-events:none}
.persona-controls{padding-top:22px}.persona-slider-label{padding:0 0 14px}.persona-slider-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:16px;align-items:center}.persona-slider{--fill:0%;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;width:100%;height:7px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#e7ff38 0 var(--fill),#303030 var(--fill) 100%);outline:none}.persona-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;background:#f6f5ef;border:4px solid #282828;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(231,255,56,.18);cursor:grab}.persona-slider::-moz-range-thumb{width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;background:#f6f5ef;border:4px solid #282828;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(231,255,56,.18);cursor:grab}.persona-play{appearance:none;border:0;background:#f5f4ee;color:#090909;border-radius:999px;padding:13px 19px;font-weight:950;font-size:.92rem;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;min-width:106px}.persona-play:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#e7ff38}.persona-play.playing{background:#e7ff38}

/* === React Bits inspired Dock navigation — adapted to standalone HTML === */
.site-header{overflow:visible}
.dock-nav{
  --dock-base:42px;
  --dock-mag:66px;
  --dock-gap:7px;
  position:relative;
  display:flex;
  align-items:flex-end;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:var(--dock-gap);
  height:54px;
  padding:6px 8px;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
  border-radius:18px;
  background:rgba(13,13,15,.72);
  box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.34),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035);
  backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.12);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(18px) saturate(1.12);
  isolation:isolate;
}
.dock-nav:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 130%,rgba(98,114,255,.12),transparent 58%);opacity:.9}
.nav.dock-nav a.dock-nav-item{
  --dock-size:var(--dock-base);
  --dock-lift:0px;
  position:relative;
  z-index:1;
  width:var(--dock-size);
  height:var(--dock-size);
  flex:0 0 var(--dock-size);
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  padding:0;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.105);
  border-radius:13px;
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(255,255,255,.055),rgba(255,255,255,.018));
  color:#bdbdb8;
  box-shadow:0 5px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.22),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.025);
  transform:translateY(var(--dock-lift));
  transform-origin:center bottom;
  transition:border-color .18s ease,background .18s ease,color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease;
  will-change:width,height,transform;
  outline:none;
}
.nav.dock-nav a.dock-nav-item:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-4px;width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);transform:translateX(-50%) scale(0);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(202,255,58,.7);transition:transform .2s ease}
.nav.dock-nav a.dock-nav-item:hover,.nav.dock-nav a.dock-nav-item:focus-visible{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(202,255,58,.42);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(202,255,58,.13),rgba(98,114,255,.08));box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.34),0 0 0 1px rgba(202,255,58,.04)}
.nav.dock-nav a.dock-nav-item.active{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(202,255,58,.35);background:rgba(202,255,58,.075)}
.nav.dock-nav a.dock-nav-item.active:after{transform:translateX(-50%) scale(1)}
.dock-nav-icon{width:42%;height:42%;display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none}
.dock-nav-icon svg{width:100%;height:100%;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.75;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;overflow:visible}
.dock-nav-label{
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:calc(100% + 12px);
  transform:translate(-50%,-5px) scale(.96);
  opacity:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  white-space:nowrap;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);
  border-radius:9px;
  background:rgba(12,12,14,.92);
  box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.34);
  padding:6px 9px;
  color:#f5f4ef;
  font-size:.67rem;
  line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:.035em;
  transition:opacity .16s ease,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}
.dock-nav-item:hover .dock-nav-label,.dock-nav-item:focus-visible .dock-nav-label{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0) scale(1)}
@media(max-width:1050px){.dock-nav{display:none}}
